notes: Described as SFP+ form-factor for 25Gbps Ethernet. FEC required in host equipment. Optical parameters specified at 25.78Gbps (25GE) and BER 5x10-5. Power budget 13–30.2 dB. Dispersion penalty < 3.0 dB. TS2014-S30C-SO: operating temperature 0°C to +70°C, power consumption < 2.5W @ 0°C to +70°C. TS2014-S30I-SO: operating temperature -40°C to +85°C, power consumption < 3.5W @ -40°C to +85°C. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Footnote 1): average power min for receiver sensitivity -31 dBm and minimum input power typical -28.1 dBm is informative. Footnote 2): OMA receiver sensitivity -26.5 dBm and -28.1 dBm are typical individual-component values. Tx output power min/max are average power; OMA min +3.7 dBm, max +7.8 dBm.
